blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever has a spare mount, let him give it to the one who has no mount; and whoever has spare provisions (beyond his own need), let him give them to the one who has no provisions,” the Prophet ﷺ said. The narrator of the hadith says, “In this way the Prophet ﷺ spoke about various kinds of goods. (Because Rasulullah ﷺ encouraged us) we came to feel that none of us had any right to the surplus goods in his possession. (The one who has no goods has more right to those goods).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ حَدَّثَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَغْزُوَ قَالَ: يَا مَعْشَرَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَاْلاَنْصَارِ! إِنَّ مِنْ إِخْوَانِكُمْ قَوْماً لَيْسَ لَهُمْ مَالٌ وَلَا عَشِيرَةٌ فَلْيَضُمَّ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَيْهِ الرَّجُلَيْنِ أَوِ الثَّلَاثَةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه ابو داؤد، باب الرجل يتحمل بمال غيره يغزو، رقم:٢٥٣٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) says, “O Muhajirin and Ansar! There are some people among you who have neither wealth nor relatives. So, let each one of you take two or three of them along with him,” Rasulullah ﷺ said when setting out for battle.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْمُطْعِمِ بْنِ الْمِقْدَامِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا خَلَّفَ عَبْدٌ عَلي أَهْلِهِ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ يَرْكَعُهُمَا عِنْدَهُمْ حِينَ يُرِيدُ سَفَرًا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ابي شيبة حديث ضعيف، الجامع الصغير، ٢ /٤٩٥، ورد عليه صاحب الاتحاف وملخص كلامه ان الحديث ليس بضعيف، اتحاف السادة: ٣ /٤٦٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “When a person goes on a journey, the best of the helpers he leaves behind for his family is the two rak'ahs he prayed among his family,” Hazrat Mut'im ibn Miqdam (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.
